table.name: TLGNR_SORG_BS
table.description: Reference data table for the Sales Organisation (aka VKO/VKORG). The attributes used for PDF data (address of the SORG) have been split in _BS/_TX according to requirements for language dependency.

column.name: SORG_CD
column.description: PK. S101, S128, S160, ... A Sales Org. is used often in combination with Sales Area, which is composed by Sales Org. + Distribution Channel + Division. Do not confuse these two!

column.name: COMPANYCODE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_companycode_bs. The company code as known in SAP (BUKRS), e.g.: FR01, BG01 which 'owns' the sales organization.

column.name: SORG_NAME
column.description: Name of the VKO used in the application besides the Code. Examples: CH-Zement, CH-Georoc, D-Zement, ...

column.name: LOGO_IMAGE_NAME
column.description: Name of image to be used on output documents (delivery note) as the logo. Reference to TLGNC_IMAGE.IMAGE_NAME. Example: pdf_crh_logo.

column.name: ADDRESS_STREET
column.description: Text to be used as line 2 on output documents (delivery note): the street including house number. Example: Dormettinger Strasse 23. Address is dependent on local post office, therefore language-independent.

column.name: ADDRESS_COUNTRYCITY
column.description: Text to be used as line 3 on output documents (delivery note): the country/zip-code/city. Example: D - 72359 Dotternhausen. Address is dependent on local post office, therefore language-independent.

column.name: SKIP_SEND_DISTANCE_SAP_SD
column.description: Flag to determine if the distance data is to be sent to SAP in ShipmentDocument, currently we do not send it for cluster 0 SORGs, namely BE10, BE12, 'BE20', BE80, FR10, FR11.

column.name: SALESDOC_RETURN_AUART
column.description: The AUART (sales order type) value to use at return orders (e.g. retrn pallet order) when creating SAP sales document. WS field to SAP: SalesDocumentCreation / sales_document_notification / document_header_organizational_data (E1EDK14) / AUART.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
